name: Honda NSR250R
engine: 249 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke V-twin, two carbs, oil injection, power valves
intro: Honda's two-stroke sport bike, built for Japan. Power valves, oil injection and electronics that are hard to replace.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Most of these were sold new outside the US, so the NHTSA search may not cover them. Ask a Honda dealer to check the frame number.
